mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_card_bin_library_activation (activation_id, version_id, previous_version_id, activation_type, operator_account_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{activationId}, #{versionId}, #{previousVersionId}, #{activationType,javaType=com.paytech.card.api.enums.BinLibraryActivationType,typeHandler=com.paytech.foundation.mybatis.typehandler.CodeEnumTypeHandler,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{operatorAccountId}, #{createTime,typeHandler=com.paytech.foundation.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateTime,typeHandler=com.paytech.foundation.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT a.activation_type, v.version_no, p.version_no AS previous_version_no, a.operator_account_id, a.create_time FROM t_card_bin_library_activation a JOIN t_card_bin_library_version v ON v.version_id = a.version_id LEFT JOIN t_card_bin_library_version p ON p.version_id = a.previous_version_id ORDER BY a.create_time DESC, a.activation_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
